lines.text: God promises to rebuild Virgin Israel, and watchmen on the hills of Ephraim will call everyone to go up to Zion.
God will bring them from the land of the north, and He will lead them beside streams of waters on a level path.
The One who scattered Israel will gather them and keep them as a king keeps his army.
Rachel weeps in Bethlehem for her children, but the LORD says they will return from the land of the enemy.
When God restores them, the people in the land of Judah will speak a blessing, and He will refresh the weary soul.
